rows.title: Passive Subdomain Enumeration
rows.objective: Review amass, Subfinder, crt.sh to discover subdomains without active probing.

rows.title: Active Subdomain / Vhost Fuzzing
rows.objective: Verify fFUF/Gobuster vhost mode to find non-public subdomains and virtual hosts.

rows.title: Technology Stack Fingerprinting
rows.objective: Review wappalyzer, WhatWeb, response headers to identify frameworks, servers, CDN.

rows.title: JavaScript Source and Endpoint Analysis
rows.objective: Check JS bundles and source maps for exposed source, hardcoded keys (e.g., unrestricted Google API keys that can incur billing charges or access GCP resources), internal endpoint references, URLs, API routes, hidden paths, and parameterized endpoints. Use static extraction plus crawling to correlate JS-linked endpoints with reachable attack surface.

rows.title: Cloud Storage & Exposed Bucket Discovery
rows.objective: Search for exposed S3/GCS/Azure buckets via naming patterns to data leakage risk.

rows.title: Subdomain Takeover Check
rows.objective: Check dangling CNAME records pointing to deprovisioned cloud services (S3, GitHub Pages, Heroku).

rows.title: Security Headers Configuration Review
rows.objective: Verify missing HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Permissions-Policy, CORS Misconfiguration.

rows.title: TLS/SSL Configuration
rows.objective: Verify weak ciphers, TLS 1.0/1.1 support, self-signed cert, expired cert to testssl.sh.

rows.title: HTTP Methods Enumeration
rows.objective: Test OPTIONS, TRACE, PUT, DELETE and verb-tunneling headers (X-HTTP-Method-Override, X-Method-Override) to identify dangerous methods enabled or override acceptance that changes POST into PUT/PATCH/DELETE.

rows.title: HTTP Strict Transport Security Review
rows.objective: Verify HSTS is present, correctly scoped, long-lived enough for the engagement context, and compatible with preload expectations where applicable.

rows.title: HTTP Request Smuggling / Desync Testing
rows.objective: Test CL.TE, TE.CL, H2.CL, and H2.TE desync behavior to identify cache poisoning, front-end auth bypass, request queue poisoning, or delivered XSS through parser disagreement.

rows.title: SQL Injection
rows.objective: Verify error-based, blind time-based (SLEEP/WAITFOR), Boolean, OOB. Tools: sqlmap -u URL --level=5 --risk=3. Test all input types including cookies/headers/JSON keys.

rows.title: NoSQL Injection
rows.objective: Verify mongoDB operator injection ($where, $gt) in JSON bodies.

rows.title: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
rows.objective: Test reflected, stored, and DOM-based XSS across user-controlled inputs, URL fragments, client-side data flows, and rendered persisted content. Include encoding, context, and sanitizer bypass checks inside the parent XSS test rather than as standalone bypass rows.

rows.title: Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI)
rows.objective: Identify engine from error (Jinja2, Twig, Freemarker, Pebble). Probe: {{7*7}}, ${7*7}, #{7*7}. Escalate to RCE via class loader or exec. Check user-controlled email/report templates.

rows.title: Command Injection
rows.objective: Verify oS injection in filename, conversion params, ping fields. Payloads: ; id, | id, $(id). Blind: time-based (sleep 5) or OOB DNS callback (curl attacker.com).

rows.title: HTTP Header Injection (CRLF)
rows.objective: Inject CRLF sequences to split responses, set cookies, redirect.

rows.title: XXE Injection
rows.objective: Verify external entity injection in XML input to file read, SSRF, blind OOB.

rows.title: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA)
rows.objective: Verify manipulate object IDs in API paths/params to access other users' resources.

rows.title: Mass Assignment / Excessive Data Exposure
rows.objective: Verify pOST/PUT with extra fields to check if they're written; check response for over-exposed fields.

rows.title: Improper Inventory — Hidden API Versions
rows.objective: Verify try /v1/, /v2/, /api/v0/, /internal/, /admin/ to older versions often lack new auth controls.

rows.title: API Security Misconfiguration
rows.objective: Verify swagger/OpenAPI portal exposed, debug mode, stack traces, default credentials on API gateway.

rows.title: Unrestricted Resource Consumption
rows.objective: Verify no rate limiting on expensive API operations to batch requests, large payloads.

rows.title: Web Cache Deception / Poisoning
rows.objective: Verify path confusion (app.com/account/style.css), unkeyed header poisoning (X-Forwarded-Host).

rows.title: Automated and Dependency Vulnerability Scan
rows.objective: Review and validate findings from automated vulnerability scans (e.g., Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP) and identify known CVEs in application dependencies.

rows.title: HTML Injection
rows.objective: Inject HTML tags/attributes in reflected and stored contexts to verify untrusted markup cannot alter UI, links, email/report content, or phishing surfaces even when script execution is blocked.

rows.title: Directory Fuzzing
rows.objective: Verify fuzz directories and content recursively, review robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and /.well-known/ paths, and enumerate hidden/admin/debug/API paths.

rows.title: Insecure Deserialization
rows.objective: Verify java: ysoserial payloads via Burp Deserialization Scanner; magic bytes AC ED 00 05. PHP: unserialize() with POP chain via __wakeup/__destruct. Python: pickle.loads() RCE. .NET: BinaryFormatter, ViewState without MAC key (ysoserial.net).

rows.title: HTTP Parameter Pollution (HPP)
rows.objective: Verify duplicate params with different values: ?id=1&id=2, array notation id[]=1. PHP uses last value; ASP.NET joins with comma. Target: access control bypass, WAF evasion, OAuth redirect_uri manipulation.

rows.title: Prototype Pollution
rows.objective: Inject __proto__[polluted]=1 or constructor[prototype][polluted]=1 in JSON body, query params, URL fragments. Use Burp DOM Invader for client-side sinks. Server-side: Node.js lodash/merge vulnerable patterns can lead to RCE.

rows.title: PHP-specific Attack Surface
rows.objective: Verify phpinfo.php discloses full config and paths. LFI wrappers: php://filter/read=convert.base64-encode, php://input, data://text/plain;base64,. Type juggling: 0e magic hash bypass for loose == comparison. Check allow_url_include, auto_prepend_file.

rows.title: ASP.NET-specific Attack Surface
rows.objective: Verify web.config via path traversal or IIS tilde shortname (8.3 filename ~). ViewState tampering if MAC key absent to ysoserial.net TypeConfuseDelegate. Trace.axd, elmah.axd exposure. ASPXAUTH cookie forging if machineKey leaked.

rows.title: Java / Tomcat-specific Attack Surface
rows.objective: Verify tomcat Manager (/manager/html, /manager/text) default creds (tomcat:tomcat, admin:admin) to WAR deploy for RCE. CVEs: CVE-2017-12617 PUT JSP upload, CVE-2020-1938 AJP Ghostcat. Spring Boot: /actuator/heapdump, /actuator/env. WEB-INF/web.xml disclosure.

rows.title: Node.js-specific Attack Surface
rows.objective: Verify prototype pollution via lodash/merge (< 4.17.11). Debug port exposure (--inspect 0.0.0.0:9229) -> RCE via DevTools protocol. ReDoS via user-supplied input to RegExp. npm audit for known CVEs. Dynamic require() path traversal in user-controlled input.

rows.title: Port And Service Exposure Scan
rows.objective: Verify run controlled TCP/UDP port discovery against in-scope web hosts and edge IPs, then fingerprint exposed services to identify unintended admin panels, databases, debug listeners, alternate HTTP services, or insecure management ports.

rows.title: API Request Integrity / HMAC Signing
rows.objective: Test for client-side request signing or HMAC verification on API calls. Attempt to replay modified requests with forged hashes to bypass server-side integrity controls.

rows.title: Token Lifecycle Enforcement
rows.objective: Verify that the issuance of a new session token automatically invalidates any previously active tokens for the same session or user context.

rows.title: Token Pattern Analysis
rows.objective: Analyze newly generated session tokens for identifiable patterns. Check for predictability, sequential numbering, or weak entropy in token generation.

rows.title: Default Credentials Test
rows.objective: Verify try admin/admin, vendor defaults on login panels, admin paths.

rows.title: Account Enumeration Via Login Responses
rows.objective: Verify compare valid and invalid identifiers across login, forgot-password, and authentication error states for differences in status code, body, timing, headers, lockout behavior, or side-channel response size.

rows.title: Login Brute Force, Rate Limit, And Lockout Enforcement
rows.objective: Verify attempt password spraying, credential stuffing, OTP-style guessing, and repeated login attempts; verify lockout, throttling, CAPTCHA/step-up, IP/account/device limits, and bypass variants such as X-Forwarded-For rotation, spoofed IP headers, slow timing, and distributed attempts.

rows.title: JWT Security Testing
rows.objective: Verify alg:none, RS256→HS256 confusion, weak secret brute force (hashcat), JWK injection, kid path traversal, expired token acceptance.

rows.title: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC Deep Testing
rows.objective: Verify redirect_uri bypass, PKCE downgrade, state CSRF, scope upgrade, authorization code injection, dynamic client registration SSRF (jwks_uri, logo_uri).

rows.title: MFA / OTP Bypass And Replay Resistance
rows.objective: Test OTP brute force, response manipulation, backup-code abuse, step skipping, used-code replay, cross-account OTP reuse, and channel swapping. Test forced browsing bypass: while on the 2FA page without inputting the code, try to access an authenticated page directly.

rows.title: Password Reset Token And Reset-link Security
rows.objective: Test reset token entropy, predictability, reuse after consumption, expiry, concurrent use/race conditions, account binding, host/header poisoning, and attacker-controlled reset-link generation in email or app-link flows.

rows.title: Session Token Analysis
rows.objective: Check entropy, predictability, and length of session tokens.

rows.title: Cookie Attribute Review
rows.objective: Review secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict/Lax, Domain/Path scope.

rows.title: Session Fixation
rows.objective: Verify pre-auth session token reuse post-login to force victim to use known token.

rows.title: CSRF Testing
rows.objective: Verify missing/bypassable CSRF token, SameSite=None misuse, referer bypass.

rows.title: Session Invalidation On Logout And Lifecycle Changes
rows.objective: Verify replay captured cookies, bearer tokens, JWTs, refresh tokens, and server sessions after logout, password change, MFA change, device removal, or account deactivation to verify server-side invalidation and token blacklisting.

rows.title: Session Timeout Enforcement
rows.objective: Verify idle timeout, absolute timeout to verify server enforces, not just client.

rows.title: Forced Browsing / Direct Object Reference
rows.objective: Verify access restricted pages/objects without proper authorization (IDOR).

rows.title: Horizontal Privilege Escalation
rows.objective: Verify access resources belonging to peer-level users by manipulating IDs.

rows.title: Vertical Privilege Escalation
rows.objective: Verify access admin/higher-privilege functions as a low-privilege user.

rows.title: File Download Path Traversal And Authorization Bypass
rows.objective: Verify manipulate filenames, paths, download IDs, document IDs, archive entries, signed URLs, and encoded traversal payloads to verify file read/download flows cannot expose files outside the intended directory or another user/tenant document.

rows.title: Broken Function Level Authorization (BFLA)
rows.objective: Verify access admin-level API endpoints as regular user by direct call.

rows.title: SSRF And Unsafe Server-side URL Fetching
rows.objective: Test every server-side URL fetcher, including import-from-URL, webhooks, previews, callbacks, and third-party API consumers, for direct and blind SSRF, metadata access, localhost/internal reachability, redirect bypasses, DNS rebinding, protocol smuggling, and allowlist/filter bypass variants.

rows.title: File Upload Validation, Active-content, And Processing Abuse
rows.objective: Verify upload attacker-controlled files including executable/web-shell payloads, renamed files, double extensions, SVG/HTML/PDF/office documents, archives, polyglots, oversized files, malicious filenames, metadata payloads, and preview/parser-triggering content; verify server-side MIME, extension, content, malware, storage-location, execution, output-encoding, SSRF, parser, and client-side bypass protections.

rows.title: Race Conditions
rows.objective: Verify concurrent requests on limit-once operations to coupon use, refund, account creation.

rows.title: Negative / Zero Value Inputs
rows.objective: Verify negative price, zero quantity in payment/transaction flows.

rows.title: Workflow / Step Bypass
rows.objective: Verify skip payment step, confirmation step to manipulate sequence via direct requests.

rows.title: GraphQL Introspection And Schema Enumeration
rows.objective: Verify enable introspection to dump schema, find hidden mutations/queries.

rows.title: GraphQL — Query Depth / Batching DoS
rows.objective: Verify deeply nested queries, alias-based brute force, batch mutation abuse.

rows.title: GraphQL — IDOR Via Nested Queries
rows.objective: Verify access related objects through nested query chains bypassing direct auth checks.

rows.title: WebSocket — Auth Bypass & Injection
rows.objective: Verify connect without valid session, inject payloads, cross-site WebSocket hijacking (CSWSH).

rows.title: LLM / AI Prompt Injection
rows.objective: Verify user-controlled input passed to AI features to inject instructions to alter AI behavior or exfil data.

rows.title: Open Redirect In OAuth / OIDC Redirect Flows
rows.objective: Verify abuse redirect_uri, post_logout_redirect_uri, or relay/state-driven redirect flows to leak tokens, bypass allowlists, or chain phishing through a trusted OAuth / OIDC entrypoint.

rows.title: Email Verification Bypass
rows.objective: Verify access authenticated endpoints before verifying email. Test: change email to victim after verifying original, reuse token across accounts, IDOR on verify endpoint (/verify?token=X&user=Y), skip verification step via response manipulation.

rows.title: Password Policy Enforcement
rows.objective: Test min length (try 1-char), complexity bypass, common passwords (check Pwned Passwords). Verify server-side enforcement not just client-side JS. Test change/reset flows separately to policy often inconsistently applied.

rows.title: Injection In Login Fields
rows.objective: Review for SQLi and NoSQLi in login fields, and verify that all credentials and tokens are submitted securely over encrypted HTTPS channels.

rows.title: Auth Bypass — HTTP Verb Confusion / Override
rows.objective: Verify swap GET↔POST on auth endpoints; also test X-HTTP-Method-Override / X-Method-Override for auth-check inconsistencies or unintended verb routing to privileged actions.

rows.title: Race Condition On Account Creation
rows.objective: Verify concurrent signup requests with same email to duplicate account or credit bonus.

rows.title: Email Parameter Manipulation
rows.objective: Verify add second email via %20, comma, CC param to attacker receives verification link.

rows.title: Referral / Invite Code Abuse
rows.objective: Verify reuse expired codes, self-referral, negative credit manipulation.

rows.title: Change Without Old Password Verification
rows.objective: Verify cSRF or direct API call to change password without providing current password.

rows.title: Cross-user Password Change (IDOR)
rows.objective: Verify manipulate user_id or account param to change another user's password.

rows.title: Unauthorized Profile Read (IDOR)
rows.objective: Verify access other users' profile data by manipulating ID in request.

rows.title: Unauthorized Profile Modification
rows.objective: Verify modify another user's profile fields via IDOR on update endpoint.

rows.title: Stored XSS In Profile Fields
rows.objective: Inject XSS in display name, bio, address to fires when admin or other user views profile.

rows.title: Injection In Session-related Headers
rows.objective: Verify x-Forwarded-For, User-Agent, Referer to injected into logs or DB queries.

rows.title: LFI Via Language Parameter
rows.objective: Verify lang=../../../../etc/passwd to test path traversal in locale/language params.

rows.title: Injection In Locale Setting
rows.objective: Inject special chars in language/timezone params to backend processing.

rows.title: Unauthorized User Creation/deletion
rows.objective: Verify create or delete users under another vendor's account via BFLA.

rows.title: Privilege Escalation In User Creation
rows.objective: Verify create a user with higher role than your own by tampering role param.

rows.title: Cross-tenant Transaction Access
rows.objective: Verify access or refund transactions belonging to another vendor/user via IDOR.

rows.title: Payment Race, Replay, And Idempotency Abuse
rows.objective: Verify send concurrent refund/payment/confirmation requests and replay payment callbacks or confirmation messages to verify double-spend, double-refund, duplicate-credit, and idempotency protections.

rows.title: Payment Amount, Price, And Currency Tampering
rows.objective: Verify modify amount, price, quantity, discount, tax, currency, exchange-rate, negative/zero value, and client-calculated totals in payment requests to verify server-side recalculation and authorization.

rows.title: Payment Step Bypass
rows.objective: Verify skip payment confirmation step by directly calling post-payment endpoint.

rows.title: Injection In Payment Reference Fields
rows.objective: Verify sQLi/XSS in payment note, reference, description fields.

rows.title: Injection In QR/PDF Generation
rows.objective: Verify sSTI or command injection via user-controlled data rendered into QR/PDF.

rows.title: QR Payment Bypass From Mini-app
rows.objective: Verify manipulate KHQR payload amount or recipient to bypass payment validation.

rows.title: Coupon Stacking Race Condition
rows.objective: Verify apply same coupon concurrently from multiple tabs/requests.

rows.title: Unauthorized Coupon Code Access
rows.objective: Verify access coupon list or codes belonging to another vendor via IDOR.

rows.title: Coupon Price Manipulation
rows.objective: Verify intercept discount value in request to modify to 100% or negative.

rows.title: SQLi / NoSQLi In Search Query
rows.objective: Test search endpoint for injection to error-based, blind, time-based.

rows.title: SSTI In Search / Template Rendering
rows.objective: Test {{7*7}} and similar payloads if search term is rendered in template context.

rows.title: Reflected XSS In Search Results
rows.objective: Search term echoed unescaped in results page.

rows.title: HTML Injection In Email Templates
rows.objective: Verify user-controlled content in email to inject HTML to create phishing template.

rows.title: Exported Content And Report Generation Injection
rows.objective: Verify place attacker-controlled values into CSV/Excel/PDF/HTML/report exports and verify spreadsheet formulas, DDE/hyperlink payloads, HTML/script content, SSTI, SSRF, and server-side renderer/template injection variants are neutralized before download or report generation.

rows.title: IDOR In Report/export Download
rows.objective: Verify manipulate report_id or export_id in download endpoint to access other users' exported data.

rows.title: Malicious File Import Parser Abuse
rows.objective: Verify import crafted CSV, XLSX, XML, archive, or document payloads and verify parsers reject XXE, formula execution, macro/active content, unsafe deserialization, parser crashes, and resource-exhaustion variants.

rows.title: Bulk Import Validation And Mapping Abuse
rows.objective: Verify import bulk records with negative values, duplicate IDs, role/owner/tenant/account fields, object identifiers, and mapping changes to verify per-item validation, authorization, tenant isolation, and overwrite protections.

rows.title: Invite Token Reuse Across Tenants
rows.objective: Verify reuse or swap invite tokens between orgs, roles, or expired states to join the wrong tenant.

rows.title: Privilege Escalation Through Invite Role Tampering
rows.objective: Verify modify role, team, or org_id fields during invite acceptance to gain elevated membership.

rows.title: Magic-link Replay Or Cross-device Reuse
rows.objective: Verify reuse consumed or stale magic links across browsers/devices to confirm one-time enforcement.

rows.title: SSO State/relay Parameter Tampering
rows.objective: Verify alter relayState, returnTo, tenant, or state to pivot accounts, tenants, or post-login redirects.

rows.title: Stored XSS Through Rich-text Editor Payloads
rows.objective: Inject HTML/Markdown/mention payloads that survive sanitization and execute in other user contexts.

rows.title: Attachment/embed SSRF In Comment Previews
rows.objective: Verify abuse image, unfurl, or embed fetchers in comments to force server-side requests to internal hosts.

rows.title: Subscription Entitlement Bypass And Plan Downgrade
rows.objective: Verify downgrade a subscription plan while retaining premium entitlements by replaying old tokens, manipulating plan/tier parameters, or tampering with client-side entitlement state. Verify the server enforces plan changes immediately and revokes higher-tier access.

rows.title: Payment Callback Tampering And Receipt Replay
rows.objective: Verify replay or alter subscription/payment status callbacks to activate service without a settled payment. Test idempotency key bypass, callback signature tampering, and status parameter manipulation (failed → paid). Verify server-side validation before granting entitlements.

rows.title: SSL Pinning Bypass — Objection / Frida
rows.objective: Verify objection: android sslpinning disable; Frida: akabe1/frida-multiple-unpinning; Reflutter for Flutter apps.

rows.title: Root / RASP Detection Bypass
rows.objective: Verify magisk allowlist, Magisk Alpha, Frida hook targeting root detection logic.

rows.title: Insecure Debuggable Flag Configuration
rows.objective: Verify decompile APK with MobSF or Jadx and check android:debuggable=true in the <application> tag of a release build. Enables ADB debugging on non-rooted devices and exposes the app to runtime inspection.

rows.title: Android Component Exposure Review
rows.objective: Review AndroidManifest.xml and runtime registrations for exported activities, services, receivers, providers, intent filters, deep-link handlers, FileProvider paths, and unsafe component exposure. Test direct invocation, provider leakage, receiver abuse, intent redirection, and fragment injection inside this parent component review.

rows.title: Hardcoded Secrets In Source
rows.objective: Verify jadx decompile to search for API keys (e.g., unrestricted Google API keys that can incur billing charges or access GCP resources), tokens, DB credentials, internal URLs in strings.xml and code.

rows.title: Flutter Reverse Engineering (Blutter)
rows.objective: Verify blutter.py on arm64-v8a/libapp.so to extract Dart snapshot, generate Frida hook scripts from function offsets.

rows.title: React Native Bundle Extraction
rows.objective: Verify adb pull then: npx react-native-decompiler or strings to extract index.android.bundle; search for API keys, endpoints, secrets, internal URLs in plain JS source.

rows.title: Deep Link And App Link Enumeration
rows.objective: Enumerate registered scheme, intent-filter, Launch crafted app links/custom schemes with injected parameters, attacker URLs, traversal payloads, OAuth/token-theft chains, hidden routes, and WebView destinations to verify routing, allowlists, confirmation, and downstream validation.

rows.title: Sensitive Data In SharedPreferences
rows.objective: Verify adb shell "run-as <pkg> cat /data/data/<pkg>/shared_prefs/*.xml" to tokens, passwords, PII in plaintext XML. Flagged: any key containing token/auth/pass/secret.

rows.title: Sensitive Data In SQLite Databases
rows.objective: Verify adb shell "run-as <pkg> ls /data/data/<pkg>/databases/" then sqlite3 to dump all tables, check for tokens, credentials, PII stored unencrypted.

rows.title: Logcat Data Leakage
rows.objective: Verify adb logcat to check for credentials, tokens, PII logged during app operation.

rows.title: Sensitive Data In Backups
rows.objective: Verify adb backup -apk -shared <pkg> to check if backup is allowed and what data is exposed.

rows.title: Memory Dump For Sensitive Data
rows.objective: Verify fridump: frida -U -f <pkg> --no-pause -l fridump.py -- -s. Grep dump for token=, Bearer, password=, private_key. Also: adb shell "cat /proc/<pid>/maps" for memory regions.

rows.title: Root/jailbreak Detection Strength
rows.objective: Test detection with Magisk Hide, Zygisk/Shamiko to how robust is detection?.

rows.title: APK Binary Integrity Check
rows.objective: Verify application integrity by attempting to repackage, sign, and install modified binaries to bypass client-side controls.

rows.title: Frida / Instrumentation Detection
rows.objective: Verify app detects Frida gadget or ptrace to test bypass via Frida anti-detection scripts.

rows.title: Tapjacking and Overlay Attacks
rows.objective: Verify build PoC overlay app (TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY). Target: payment confirm, auth screen. Check filterTouchesWhenObscured=true in layout XML or setFilterTouchesWhenObscured() in code (Jadx).

rows.title: Accessibility Service Abuse
rows.objective: Verify malicious app with AccessibilityService can read all on-screen text including passwords and OTPs. Check if app implements AccessibilityService detection. Also: does app content show in accessibility tree (getContentDescription leak)?.

rows.title: API Server Ports And Services Exposure Scan
rows.objective: Identify API backend hosts, IPs, and loopback services used by the mobile app, then run controlled port discovery and service fingerprinting to find unintended admin panels, databases, debug listeners, or alternate API ports.

rows.title: Directory And Content Discovery On Mobile API Backend
rows.objective: Verify use ffuf/dirsearch against mobile API base URLs to discover robots.txt, sitemap.xml, /.well-known/ endpoints, backup files, and hidden admin paths exposed by the backend.

rows.title: Security Headers Review On Mobile API Backend
rows.objective: Verify intercept API responses with Burp Suite and verify X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security are present. Check for Server/X-Powered-By information disclosure.

rows.title: Cloud Storage And Exposed Bucket Discovery
rows.objective: Verify search decompiled code and network traffic for AWS S3, GCP, or Azure blob URLs, as well as hardcoded Firebase Realtime Database URLs (*.firebaseio.com). Test buckets for anonymous read/write access or directory listing using tools like CloudEnum, and test Firebase URLs by appending /.json to check for unauthenticated data access.

rows.title: Known CVE Scan On Mobile API Dependencies
rows.objective: Identify API server technology from response headers (framework, version). Cross-reference against CVE databases and run Nuclei templates against the API base URL for known vulnerabilities.

rows.title: Hidden API Version Discovery
rows.objective: Enumerate undocumented or deprecated API versions (e.g., /v0/, /v2/, /beta/, /internal/) by fuzzing version path segments. Test whether older versions lack current auth controls or rate limiting.

rows.title: TLS/SSL Configuration On Mobile API
rows.objective: Test the API backend TLS configuration: weak cipher suites, TLS 1.0/1.1 support, self-signed or expired certificates, certificate chain issues, and HSTS enforcement.

rows.title: HTTP Methods Enumeration On Mobile API
rows.objective: Verify send OPTIONS/HEAD/TRACE/PUT/DELETE to API endpoints. Identify methods enabled beyond GET/POST. Test whether restricted methods bypass authorization.

rows.title: Emulator Detection Bypass
rows.objective: Identify emulator detection triggers (build props, sensor absence, AVD artifacts, IMEI patterns). Bypass using modified emulator images, Frida hooks targeting detection functions, or property spoofing. Confirm security controls do not solely rely on emulator detection.

rows.title: Accessibility Service Detection Bypass
rows.objective: Check if the app detects and blocks accessibility services (screen readers, overlays, automation). Bypass with Frida hooks or disabled service flags. Verify security-critical flows are not solely protected by accessibility detection.

rows.title: AndroidManifest — Android:allowBackup=true
rows.objective: Check android:allowBackup=true in the <application> tag. Run: adb backup -noapk com.target.app and extract with abe.jar. Verify sensitive data (tokens, DB, prefs) is not recoverable from the backup.

rows.title: Insecure Cleartext Traffic Configuration
rows.objective: Check android:usesCleartextTraffic=true and review res/xml/network_security_config.xml for cleartext exceptions. Intercept traffic to confirm plaintext HTTP is used in production flows.

rows.title: Unprotected Exported Components
rows.objective: Review all <activity>, <receiver>, <provider>, <service> with android:exported=true or implicit intent-filters. Confirm each requires a permission. Test: adb shell am start -n com.target/.ExportedActivity.

rows.title: AndroidManifest — Over-declared Permissions
rows.objective: Verify compare declared <uses-permission> entries against actual app functionality. Flag permissions beyond scope (READ_CONTACTS, ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, CAMERA) for apps that do not need them.

rows.title: AndroidManifest — MinSdkVersion Below 24
rows.objective: Check android:minSdkVersion in the manifest. Values below 24 allow v1 JAR signing, vulnerable to Janus attack (CVE-2017-13156). Confirm via: apksigner verify --verbose app.apk.

rows.title: APK Signature Scheme Integrity
rows.objective: Verify APK is signed with v2 or v3 scheme only. Check: apksigner verify --verbose app.apk and confirm v1 signing is absent. v1-only signing is vulnerable to Janus (CVE-2017-13156). Ensure minSdkVersion >= 24 to prevent downgrade.

rows.title: API Request Integrity / HMAC Signing
rows.objective: Identify and test API request signing mechanisms (HMAC, custom hash headers). Attempt to tamper with parameters and verify if server-side integrity checks prevent unauthorized modifications.

rows.title: Token Lifecycle Enforcement
rows.objective: Verify that old session tokens are automatically invalidated server-side immediately after a new token is generated for the same user context.

rows.title: Token Pattern Analysis
rows.objective: Analyze newly issued session tokens to determine if they follow an identifiable or predictable pattern (e.g., sequential, timestamp-based, or weak randomness).

rows.title: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA) on Mobile API
rows.objective: Verify mobile API often uses different auth or lacks server-side checks to test IDOR on all object IDs.

rows.title: BFLA — Admin Functions Via Mobile API
rows.objective: Verify call privileged API functions available only via mobile client but not enforced server-side.

rows.title: Mass Assignment On Mobile Endpoints
rows.objective: Verify pOST extra fields to mobile-specific endpoints to role, balance, is_verified.

rows.title: Weak Auth On Mobile-specific Endpoints
rows.objective: Verify mobile app uses API key or device ID instead of proper auth to test without credentials.

rows.title: API Security Misconfiguration On Mobile Backend
rows.objective: Check mobile-used endpoints for exposed OpenAPI/Swagger docs, debug or staging endpoints, verbose errors, weak gateway policy, and default credentials/misconfig inherited from the shared API tier.

rows.title: Biometric Authentication Bypass
rows.objective: Verify use Frida/Objection to hook BiometricPrompt callbacks, force success branches, patch CryptoObject/null-check handling, and verify biometric gates cannot be bypassed without valid platform-backed authentication.

rows.title: Token And Credential Storage Exposure
rows.objective: Verify inspect SharedPreferences, files, databases, Keystore usage, hardcoded values, and runtime memory to verify passwords, JWTs, bearer tokens, and refresh tokens are not stored or recoverable insecurely.

rows.title: Session Token Invalidation And Expiry Enforcement
rows.objective: Verify session tokens expire upon logout, app reinstall, timeout, or manual invalidation; test for invalidation across different devices.

rows.title: WebView Trust Boundary Abuse
rows.objective: Verify inspect WebView implementations for setJavaScriptEnabled(true), addJavascriptInterface() abuse, setAllowFileAccess(true), and setAllowFileAccessFromFileURLs(true) allowing XSS to native bridge execution or local file inclusion/theft.

rows.title: Clipboard Data Leakage
rows.objective: Verify after login, trigger copy of sensitive data (password, token). adb shell "service call clipboard 2" or malicious app to read ClipboardManager. FLAG_SECURE does not protect clipboard.

rows.title: Sensitive Data On Lock Screen / Notifications
rows.objective: Verify trigger sensitive notification (OTP, balance, message). Lock device. Check if notification previews sensitive content on lock screen. NotificationCompat.VISIBILITY_SECRET should hide content.

rows.title: Screenshot Prevention
rows.objective: Verify navigate to sensitive screen (balance, auth). Press Home. Check recent apps thumbnail to sensitive screen visible = FLAG_SECURE missing. Frida: hook getWindow().setFlags to verify.

rows.title: Background Data Leakage
rows.objective: Verify background the app on a sensitive screen. Check recent apps for snapshot leakage. Also: Frida hook onPause() to does app blank content? FLAG_SECURE must be set on all sensitive Activities.

rows.title: Third-party SDK Data Leakage/over-permissioned SDKs
rows.objective: Verify decompile and identify SDKs (analytics, ads, crash reporting). Intercept traffic for PII sent to SDK endpoints (device ID, email, location). Review SDK permissions to ad SDKs requesting Camera/Contacts. Use MobSF for automated SDK inventory.

rows.title: Default Credentials Test
rows.objective: Test admin/admin, admin/password, and app-specific default credentials against the mobile login API. Try common default credential lists via Burp Intruder.

rows.title: Account Enumeration Via Login Responses
rows.objective: Verify compare server responses for valid vs. invalid usernames at the mobile login endpoint to response body, status code, and timing. Confirm a consistent generic error is returned for both.

rows.title: Login Brute Force, Rate Limit, And Lockout Enforcement
rows.objective: Verify send repeated login attempts to the mobile API login endpoint. Verify: rate limiting (HTTP 429), account lockout after N failures, and that lockout is server-side and not bypassable by clearing app data.

rows.title: MFA / OTP Bypass And Replay Resistance
rows.objective: Verify intercept MFA/OTP submission. Test: replay a used OTP, swap OTP from another account, and verify time-based expiry enforcement. Test forced browsing bypass: while on the 2FA page without inputting the code, try to access an authenticated page directly.

rows.title: Injection In Login Fields
rows.objective: Inject SQL, NoSQL, LDAP, and template payloads into mobile login fields (username/password) via Burp Suite interception. Check for auth bypass or verbose errors.

rows.title: Auth Bypass — HTTP Verb Confusion And Override
rows.objective: Test the mobile API login endpoint with alternative HTTP methods (HEAD, OPTIONS, PUT). Add X-HTTP-Method-Override headers. Verify method restrictions are consistently enforced.

rows.title: Login Response Manipulation
rows.objective: Verify intercept login response to change false→true, 401→200 in auth response fields.

rows.title: Payment Request Interception & Tampering
rows.objective: Verify intercept payment API request to modify amount, currency, recipient before server processes.

rows.title: Race Condition On Mobile Payment
rows.objective: Verify trigger payment confirmation concurrently from two devices/sessions.

rows.title: Malicious QR/deep-link Routing Abuse
rows.objective: Scan attacker-crafted QR/KHQR payloads that embed deep links, hidden app routes, mini-app/payment entrypoints, or unsafe parameters and verify explicit confirmation, routing allowlists, and trust boundaries before processing.

rows.title: Payment Step Bypass Via API Call
rows.objective: Verify skip payment UI flow to call post-payment API endpoint directly to confirm without paying.

rows.title: OTP Brute Force And Rate Limit Testing
rows.objective: Verify abuse of OTP resend endpoints (spamming) or parallel brute-force guessing of OTP codes to complete registration without owning the channel.

rows.title: OTP Channel Swap Via Client Tampering
rows.objective: Verify change phone, email, or country-code parameters after challenge issuance to bind a verified OTP to a new identity.

rows.title: Bound Device Swap Via Local State Tampering
rows.objective: Verify modify bound-device identifiers, attestation state, or registration tokens to move a session to another handset.

rows.title: Bypass Device Change Approval Workflow
rows.objective: Verify trigger device reset or recovery flows and skip step-up verification needed for re-binding.

rows.title: GraphQL Introspection And Schema Enumeration
rows.objective: Probe mobile backend GraphQL endpoints for schema introspection, hidden types, and undocumented operations exposed to the app.

rows.title: GraphQL IDOR / Mutation Abuse On Mobile API
rows.objective: Verify abuse nested queries and mutations used by the mobile app to read cross-user data, over-post fields, or modify objects outside the current tenant/session.

rows.title: Mobile WebSocket Auth Token Replay
rows.objective: Verify intercept the mobile app WebSocket handshake and replay or downgrade bearer/session tokens to test unauthorized channel reuse across devices or accounts.

rows.title: Mobile WebSocket Message / Subscription Tampering
rows.objective: Verify modify subscription IDs, event names, and message payloads in the mobile real-time channel to test unauthorized event injection and cross-user data leakage.

rows.title: OAuth Redirect URI / Deep Link Hijack
rows.objective: Verify abuse mobile redirect URIs, app links, or custom schemes in OAuth / OIDC callbacks to steal auth codes/tokens or force the flow into an attacker-controlled handler.

rows.title: PKCE, Auth Code, And State Replay In Mobile OAuth Flow
rows.objective: Verify replay or swap intercepted OAuth auth codes, PKCE verifier material, stale state/nonce values, relay parameters, tenant/account identifiers, and return targets across sessions/devices to verify callback binding and anti-CSRF controls.

rows.title: Password Reset Token Reuse In Mobile Recovery Flow
rows.objective: Verify intercept or recover reset tokens, OTPs, or deep-link parameters used by the mobile app and verify whether they can be replayed across devices or reused after successful reset.

rows.title: Reset Link / App-link Hijack In Mobile Recovery Flow
rows.objective: Verify abuse custom scheme or app-link password reset callbacks to steal reset tokens, swap the target account, or complete recovery from an attacker-controlled handler.

rows.title: Malicious File Import/share Parser Abuse
rows.objective: Verify feed attacker-controlled documents, archives, or shared files into the mobile app import flow and test for parser crashes, unsafe deserialization, or trust bypass in imported content.

rows.title: Exported Mobile Report / Statement Payload Injection
rows.objective: Verify generate exported statements, CSVs, or documents from the mobile app and test whether attacker-controlled values survive into files as formulas, scripts, or unsafe active content.

rows.title: QR Payload Tampering Before Payment Confirmation
rows.objective: Verify intercept mobile QR/KHQR payment flows and alter merchant IDs, amounts, references, or redirect parameters before the app confirms the scanned payment request.

rows.title: Mobile Coupon Code Tampering
rows.objective: Verify intercept coupon or promo-code apply requests from the mobile app and modify code, discount value, currency, eligibility, or cart binding before server validation.

rows.title: Mobile Promo Entitlement Replay
rows.objective: Verify replay or reuse consumed mobile promo grants, referral credits, or campaign rewards across accounts, devices, carts, or checkout sessions.

rows.title: Subscription Entitlement Bypass And Plan Downgrade
rows.objective: Verify downgrade a subscription plan while retaining premium entitlements. Tamper local subscription cache (SharedPreferences, DB) and server-side plan parameters. Replay old purchase tokens. Verify the server enforces plan changes independently of client-side state.

rows.title: Payment Callback Tampering And Receipt Replay
rows.objective: Verify replay or alter billing receipts and payment callbacks at the mobile API. Test in-app purchase receipt replay, idempotency bypass, and callback parameter tampering. Verify server-side receipt validation prevents unauthorized service activation.

rows.title: Mobile File Upload Validation And Active-content Handling
rows.objective: Verify upload attacker-controlled images, documents, HTML, SVG, PDF, archives, polyglots, oversized files, and renamed payloads from the mobile client and verify server-side MIME, extension, size, malware, active-content, and same-origin serving controls.

rows.title: Mobile File Download Authorization And Token Reuse
rows.objective: Verify tamper mobile download identifiers, content:// references, cached file paths, signed URLs, download tokens, and server-generated document references across users/devices to verify authorization is enforced on every retrieval.

rows.title: Cross-account Mobile Import Mapping Abuse
rows.objective: Verify modify import mappings, owner IDs, tenant/account IDs, or object identifiers so imported records overwrite or attach to another user or tenant.

rows.title: Mobile Export Authorization And Path Handling
rows.objective: Verify tamper export IDs, report IDs, local destination paths, and cached export references to confirm exported documents cannot expose another user data or write to unsafe locations.

rows.title: Mobile Payment Replay And Idempotency
rows.objective: Verify replay payment confirmation, callback, and receipt requests from the mobile app to verify duplicate settlement, refund, and recipient changes are rejected server-side.

rows.title: Mobile Coupon Stacking Race Condition
rows.objective: Verify apply promo/coupon codes concurrently across app sessions, carts, and devices to verify stacking, reuse, and campaign limits are enforced server-side.

rows.title: Mobile Cross-site WebSocket Handshake Abuse
rows.objective: Test WebSocket handshakes for missing Origin validation, weak token binding, and unauthorized cross-account channel establishment from attacker-controlled contexts.

rows.title: Mobile GraphQL Depth And Batching Abuse
rows.objective: Verify send deeply nested, aliased, and batched mobile GraphQL operations to test resource exhaustion, authorization drift, and hidden mutation exposure.

rows.title: Mobile QR Replay And Confirmation Binding
rows.objective: Verify replay scanned QR/KHQR payloads and confirmation requests across devices/accounts to verify amount, merchant, session, and nonce binding.

rows.title: Architecture Identification (2-tier / 3-tier)
rows.objective: Verify cFF Explorer, Wireshark, netstat to determine if app speaks directly to DB or through app server.

rows.title: Technology Stack Identification
rows.objective: Verify detect It Easy (DIE), CFF Explorer to language, framework, .NET version, packer.

rows.title: Network Communication Mapping
rows.objective: Verify wireshark + netstat -ano + Resource Monitor to identify all outbound connections and protocols.

rows.title: Auth Mechanism Analysis
rows.objective: Verify observe login flow to local vs server-side, token storage location, session handling.

rows.title: Hardcoded Credential Search
rows.objective: Review strings, Ghidra, dnSpy to search decompiled/disassembled code for passwords, API keys (e.g., unrestricted Google API keys that can incur billing charges or access GCP resources), connection strings.

rows.title: Hidden UI Element Exposure
rows.objective: Verify uISpy / WinSpy++ / Snoop (WPF) / Accessibility Insights to enumerate all controls including hidden/disabled. Enable via AutomationElement.SetValue or memory patch IsEnabled property. Look for admin-only menu items.

rows.title: Disabled Functionality Activation
rows.objective: Verify x64dbg / dnSpy to set breakpoint on IsEnabled/Visible check, patch return value. For .NET: dnSpy edit-and-continue to flip condition. Memory patch button state. Target: greyed-out admin features.

rows.title: Injection Via GUI Input Fields
rows.objective: Verify all GUI text inputs: login, search, file path, filter fields. Payloads: SQLi (OR 1=1--), command injection (| calc.exe), format string (%n%n). Trace with Procmon to see if input reaches DB/shell.

rows.title: Sensitive Data In App Files
rows.objective: Verify %APPDATA%\<app>, %LOCALAPPDATA%, %TEMP%, %ProgramData% to dir /s /b *.log *.txt *.xml *.ini *.config. Search: findstr /si "password token secret key" *.* in app directories.

rows.title: Config File Sensitive Data
rows.objective: Verify app.config / Web.config / appsettings.json / *.ini / *.xml to grep for connectionString, password=, apiKey=, token=. Also check encrypted sections: aspnet_regiis -pdf to decrypt if machineKey known.

rows.title: DLL Hijacking Via Application Path
rows.objective: Verify procmon filter: Process Name = app.exe, Result = NAME NOT FOUND, Path ends with .dll to identify missing DLLs loaded from writable path. icacls on app install dir to user-writable = plant DLL.

rows.title: Sensitive Data In Registry
rows.objective: Verify regshot: snapshot before/after app login to compare HKCU/HKLM writes. Search: reg query HKCU /s /f "password" and /f "token". Also: Procmon filter RegSetValue with sensitive data.

rows.title: Writable Registry Keys For Persistence
rows.objective: Verify accessChk: accesschk.exe -kwsu "Users" HKLM\SOFTWARE\<app> to writable by non-admin = persistence or config hijack. Also check HKCU\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run for user-writable paths.

rows.title: Proxy-aware Traffic Interception
rows.objective: Verify set system proxy to 127.0.0.1:8080. Burp Suite / Fiddler (best for .NET to hooks WinHTTP). Check if app respects WinINet proxy. Fiddler: Tools > WinConfig to force proxy-unaware apps.

rows.title: Proxy-unaware Traffic Interception
rows.objective: Verify proxyCap / Proxifier to redirect by process. Echo Mirage for Winsock hook. Wireshark for raw capture. Target non-HTTP binary protocols. Look for plaintext auth, unencrypted data in custom protocol.

rows.title: Non-HTTP Traffic Analysis
rows.objective: Analyze TCP/UDP custom protocols and non-HTTP socket traffic with Wireshark, Procmon network events, and API Monitor hooks. Keep named pipe/local socket authorization checks in the IPC feature.

rows.title: Cleartext Protocol Usage
rows.objective: Review wireshark to app sending credentials or data over HTTP, FTP, Telnet unencrypted.

rows.title: .NET Decompilation & Logic Review
rows.objective: Verify dnSpy, ILSpy to decompile .NET assembly; review auth checks, license logic, crypto use.

rows.title: Java/JAR Decompilation
rows.objective: Review jadx, CFR to decompile Java thick client; JNDI injection, deserialization gadget chains.

rows.title: .NET Deserialization
rows.objective: Verify ysoserial.net: ysoserial.exe -f BinaryFormatter -g TypeConfuseDelegate -c calc.exe. Look for remoting endpoints, BinaryFormatter.Deserialize calls (dnSpy). Also ViewState without MAC to use ysoserial.net -p ViewState.

rows.title: Sensitive Data And Credential Extraction From Process Memory
rows.objective: Verify inspect process memory and dumps for credentials, bearer tokens, passwords, private keys, and sensitive runtime artifacts during authenticated workflows. Use Process Hacker/procdump/strings and debugger-assisted dumping where needed.

rows.title: Electron — ContextIsolation / NodeIntegration
rows.objective: Verify extract app.asar: npx asar extract app.asar app-src. Check main process package.json: nodeIntegration:true + contextIsolation:false = XSS leads to RCE via require("child_process"). Also check webSecurity:false.

rows.title: Electron — Preload Script Injection
rows.objective: Review preload.js to what is exposed via contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld(). Can renderer call fs, exec, shell via exposed API? Frida: hook ipcMain.on handlers for injection via IPC messages.

rows.title: Insecure Installation Directory Permissions
rows.objective: Verify icacls "C:\Program Files\<app>\*" to check for user-writable files or directories in app path. Users group write = DLL/binary plant for privilege escalation or persistence. Also check %APPDATA%\<app> for world-writable sensitive config.

rows.title: Sensitive Data In Application Event Logs
rows.objective: Verify event Viewer (eventvwr.msc) > Windows Logs > Application to filter by app name. Also: Get-EventLog -LogName Application -Source <app>. Look for credentials, tokens, SQL queries, stack traces with internal paths logged by the app itself.

rows.title: Temp File Credential Capture Technique
rows.objective: Verify lock Temp folder (disable Delete permission) before running app to credentials written to temp persist for inspection.

rows.title: Unquoted Service Path
rows.objective: Verify sc qc <service> to look for BINARY_PATH_NAME with spaces and no quotes. wmic service get name,pathname to automated check. Plant binary at first unquoted segment (e.g. C:\Program Files\Evil.exe).

rows.title: API Security From Desktop Context
rows.objective: Verify run OWASP API Top 10 against the desktop app's backend API endpoints, including BOLA, mass assignment, BFLA, and security misconfiguration such as exposed docs, debug endpoints, verbose errors, and weak gateway policy.

rows.title: AlwaysInstallElevated Check
rows.objective: Verify reg query HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Installer /v AlwaysInstallElevated && reg query HKLM\... to both must be 0x1. If set: msiexec /quiet /i malicious.msi installs as SYSTEM.

rows.title: Custom Action DLL Hijack
rows.objective: Verify procmon during install: filter msiexec.exe + CreateFile + NAME NOT FOUND to DLL in writable path = hijack.

rows.title: Credentials In MSI Tables
rows.objective: Verify myMSIAnalyzer / strings to check Property, Registry, CustomAction tables for plaintext credentials.

rows.title: MSI Repair Mode Privilege Escalation
rows.objective: Review guiFinder to identify MSIs running GUI as SYSTEM; exploit explorer.exe escape to get SYSTEM shell.

rows.title: MST Transform Backdoor (unsigned MSI)
rows.objective: Verify if MSI unsigned: craft malicious .mst transform, execute: msiexec /i legit.msi TRANSFORMS=evil.mst.

rows.title: Embedded WebView Security Boundary
rows.objective: Verify run web baseline checks against embedded CEF/Edge/WebView2 content and verify XSS, file:// access, attacker navigation, postMessage abuse, remote debugging, and rendered URLs cannot cross into native privileges unless explicitly trusted.

rows.title: DPAPI Credential Storage
rows.objective: Verify cryptUnprotectData called by same user context decrypts DPAPI blobs to Mimikatz: dpapi::blob or dpapi::cred. Find blob: dir /s %APPDATA%\*.dat. Check if app stores DPAPI-encrypted creds in registry or file.

rows.title: IPC Named Pipe And Local Socket Authorization
rows.objective: Enumerate named pipes and local sockets, inspect ACLs, connect as a low-privilege user, attempt command injection or token impersonation, and verify every privileged IPC channel requires authentication and authorization.

rows.title: Bypass Local Auth Check
rows.objective: Verify memory patch (x64dbg) or binary patch to flip auth result check from jne to je; always-true patch.

rows.title: Credential In Transit — Desktop To Server
rows.objective: Verify intercept login via Burp/Fiddler to plaintext or weakly hashed credential in transit.

rows.title: Offline Mode Bypasses Server Auth
rows.objective: Verify disconnect network to does app enter offline mode with full access? Are cached creds protected?.

rows.title: Cached Credential Protection
rows.objective: Search disk + memory + registry for cached credentials used in offline mode to DPAPI protected?.

rows.title: License Check Patch
rows.objective: Verify dnSpy/x64dbg to locate license validation function, patch return value to always-valid.

rows.title: Clock Manipulation For Trial Reset
rows.objective: Verify advance system clock to does trial period reset or extend? Check registry for trial timestamp.

rows.title: Trial State In Registry / File
rows.objective: Review regshot to find where trial state stored; delete or modify to reset trial period.

rows.title: License Server Request Tampering
rows.objective: Verify intercept license validation API to modify response to reflect valid license.

rows.title: COM Object Abuse
rows.objective: Review oleView to find COM objects registered by app; call methods without proper auth.

rows.title: XSS → RCE Via Electron Shell.openExternal
rows.objective: Verify xSS in rendered content calls shell.openExternal with attacker URL to executes OS commands.

rows.title: ContextBridge API Abuse
rows.objective: Enumerate exposed contextBridge APIs to call privileged Node.js/native functions from renderer.

rows.title: Import File Path Traversal
rows.objective: Verify file import feature to craft filename with ../../ to write/read outside intended directory.

rows.title: Malicious File Parsing (RCE)
rows.objective: Verify import specially crafted document/image to trigger parsing vulnerability (e.g., image library CVE).

rows.title: Payment API Request Tampering
rows.objective: Verify intercept payment request to modify amount, recipient, currency before server processes.

rows.title: Race Condition On Desktop Payment
rows.objective: Verify concurrent payment triggers to submit same payment twice simultaneously.

rows.title: Repair Mode Arbitrary File Overwrite
rows.objective: Verify abuse repair/self-heal paths to plant files, replace DLLs, or write into protected locations.

rows.title: Custom Installer Property Injection
rows.objective: Verify pass crafted MSI/MSIX/public properties to alter install paths, service accounts, or post-install actions.

rows.title: Sensitive Data Exposure In Local Database
rows.objective: Verify inspect SQLite/LevelDB/cache stores for tokens, credentials, report data, or decrypted secrets at rest.

rows.title: Tampered Local Cache Reaccepted By App
rows.objective: Verify modify cached entitlements, roles, or offline records and verify integrity checks occur before reuse.

rows.title: Low-privilege Control Of Privileged Service Channel
rows.objective: Verify abuse named pipes, RPC, localhost APIs, or job queues to make a service execute higher-privilege actions.

rows.title: Formula/script Payload In Exported Documents
rows.objective: Inject spreadsheet formulas, HTML, or active content into exported files consumed by internal users.

rows.title: Export Path Traversal Or Arbitrary Write
rows.objective: Verify manipulate save/export paths, templates, or filenames to write outside approved directories.

rows.title: GraphQL Introspection And Schema Enumeration
rows.objective: Identify GraphQL endpoints used by the desktop client and test schema introspection, hidden operations, and undocumented resolvers reachable from the app.

rows.title: GraphQL Mutation / IDOR Abuse Via Desktop Operations
rows.objective: Verify replay and tamper with GraphQL queries or mutations issued by the desktop app to test cross-user object access, privilege drift, and excessive field updates.

rows.title: Desktop WebSocket Auth/session Reuse
rows.objective: Verify capture the desktop app WebSocket handshake and test whether session tokens, cookies, or bearer headers can be replayed to open unauthorized real-time channels.

rows.title: Desktop WebSocket Event Injection / Subscription Tampering
rows.objective: Verify modify event subscriptions, channel identifiers, and message bodies in the desktop client WebSocket traffic to test unauthorized event injection and cross-tenant leaks.

rows.title: Desktop OAuth Callback Interception And Token Theft
rows.objective: Verify abuse loopback listeners, localhost callback ports, weak listener binding, custom URI schemes, state swapping, and attacker-controlled redirects in desktop OAuth/OIDC flows to verify auth codes and tokens cannot be intercepted or replayed.

rows.title: Imported Desktop Document/parser Abuse
rows.objective: Verify feed attacker-controlled spreadsheets, PDFs, or data files into the desktop import/open flow and verify whether parser trust, macro handling, or file-type validation can be bypassed.

rows.title: Desktop QR/KHQR Payload Tampering Before Render Or Print
rows.objective: Verify alter QR/KHQR payload fields generated or displayed by the desktop app and verify whether merchant identifiers, amounts, or references can be swapped without integrity checks.

rows.title: Scanned QR Deep-link / Protocol Abuse In Desktop Client
rows.objective: Test whether QR/KHQR scanning or imported QR payloads can invoke unsafe protocol handlers, hidden desktop routes, or privileged actions without explicit trust boundaries.

rows.title: Desktop Coupon Code Tampering
rows.objective: Verify intercept coupon or promotion apply requests from the desktop client and alter discount values, code ownership, campaign eligibility, or cart/session binding.

rows.title: Subscription Entitlement Bypass And Plan Downgrade
rows.objective: Verify downgrade the desktop subscription plan while retaining premium features by manipulating license state in local DB/registry, replaying cached entitlement responses, or tampering plan/tier parameters. Verify server-side entitlement enforcement.

rows.title: Desktop File Upload Validation Bypass
rows.objective: Verify upload attacker-controlled desktop files, renamed payloads, oversized archives, or malformed documents and verify backend validation independent of client-side checks.

rows.title: Desktop File Download Authorization Bypass
rows.objective: Verify tamper with desktop download identifiers, export paths, signed URLs, and cached document references to retrieve unauthorized files or overwrite unsafe locations.

rows.title: Desktop Backend Port And Service Exposure Scan
rows.objective: Enumerate backend hosts, update endpoints, localhost listeners, and service IPs contacted by the desktop client, then run controlled port discovery and service fingerprinting to find unintended admin panels, databases, debug listeners, or alternate API ports.

rows.title: Desktop API Object Authorization / IDOR
rows.objective: Verify replay and tamper with object IDs, tenant/account IDs, document IDs, license/account references, and sync IDs observed in desktop API traffic to verify cross-user and cross-tenant resources cannot be accessed.

rows.title: Desktop API Function-level Authorization
rows.objective: Verify call privileged, admin, maintenance, license, support, or internal desktop API functions discovered in client traffic or binaries as a low-privilege user to verify server-side function authorization.

rows.title: Desktop API Mass Assignment and Data Exposure
rows.objective: Verify add role, account_id, tenant_id, license tier, entitlement flags, sync status, hidden admin booleans, or other unexpected fields to desktop API write requests and inspect responses for overexposed secrets or authorization data.

rows.title: Weak Desktop API Authentication And Device Trust Binding
rows.objective: Test whether desktop API endpoints trust API keys, installation IDs, machine IDs, license IDs, device fingerprints, cached tokens, or desktop-only headers without server-side user/session authorization.

rows.title: Desktop API Inventory And Misconfiguration
rows.objective: Enumerate /v1, /v2, /internal, /admin, /desktop, update, license, support, and staging API routes used by the desktop client; check exposed Swagger/OpenAPI docs, verbose errors, debug endpoints, default credentials, and weak gateway policy.

rows.title: Desktop API Rate Limit And Resource Consumption
rows.objective: Verify batch, replay, and stress expensive desktop API operations such as sync, export/job triggers, search/report generation, update checks, and license validation to verify rate limits, payload bounds, and server-side resource controls.

rows.title: Desktop API Header Trust And Gateway Bypass
rows.objective: Verify tamper Host, X-Forwarded-Host, X-Forwarded-For, X-Real-IP, X-Original-URL, X-Rewrite-URL, method override, Origin, Referer, User-Agent, app-version, channel, device, installation, and license headers to test auth bypass, routing bypass, rate-limit bypass, tenant confusion, and gateway policy drift.

rows.title: Desktop API Sensitive Response Headers And Cache Policy
rows.objective: Verify inspect desktop API responses for missing Cache-Control: no-store on token or PII responses, overexposed Server/version/debug headers, permissive CORS on shared API tiers, verbose WWW-Authenticate detail, leaked request IDs, and inconsistent headers between desktop and web/mobile API routes.

rows.title: Payment Callback Tampering And Receipt Replay
rows.objective: Verify intercept desktop app payment callbacks or license activation responses. Replay captured success responses, alter status fields (failed → paid), and verify server-side idempotency enforcement prevents unauthorized service activation.
